label: GO step after an unrewarded trial, choosing a1, early-to-mid episode
explanation: Fires only at GO; never at D1 or D2. Within GO, about 95% of activation mass falls on steps after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward==0; rate 8.3% vs 0.9% after reward). It is strongly skewed toward the agent choosing a1 (model_act==1 carries 86% of mass; the top quartile is almost entirely a1 choices with large positive choice logit) and toward the first ~60 trials of an episode (activity is near zero after trial 65). It is also linked to the good state being S1 and to high value (85% of mass in the 7.73-8.10 value bin). GO & prev_reward==0 alone gives mass recall 0.95 but precision 0.25. Adding the agent own choice a1 (model_act, the policy argmax at this step, so observed and not future) and ep_trial<60 gives dev F1 0.63, mass recall 0.81, precision 0.67. Swapping ep_trial for value>7.6 scores about the same (0.64). Low-magnitude misses are mostly a1 GO steps after a rewarded trial (activation about 0.1-0.3 of max), and some a2 choices after no reward. False positives are mostly a2-leaning GO steps after no reward, or late-episode steps. Magnitude is highest for unrewarded-history a1 choices with a strongly positive choice logit.
